competitorDescription: Bolt.new is an AI website and app builder that runs in the browser. Plans are Free, Pro ($25/mo), Teams ($30 per member per month) and Enterprise.
positioning: Atai follows the business lifecycle — IDEA → BUILD → LAUNCH → MANAGE → GROW → SCALE. Bolt.new is built around generating and hosting an app in the browser.
limitations: Plans, prices and entitlements on both sides change regularly. Every row below was checked on 2026-11-15 against the source linked in that row — re-verify before you decide.

rows.atai: Plan, build, launch, manage, grow and scale a business from one platform.
rows.competitor: Build and host a website or app from a browser-based AI development environment.

rows.atai: Covers the full lifecycle: business planning and offer development, building the app, launching it, then running finances, marketing and growth.
rows.competitor: Covers building and hosting a website or app.

rows.atai: Explorer (free), Starter ($89.99/mo or $989.89/yr), Growth ($199.99/mo or $2,199.89/yr), Scale ($499.99/mo or $5,499.89/yr) and Enterprise (custom).
rows.competitor: Free ($0), Pro ($25/mo), Teams ($30 per member per month) and Enterprise, priced individually.

rows.atai: Subscription plans with a monthly Atai Credit allowance; yearly plans are paid upfront for 12 months and still receive credits every month.
rows.competitor: Tokens. The Free plan includes 1M tokens a month with a 300K daily limit; Pro starts at 10M tokens a month with no daily limit.

rows.atai: Explorer: plan your business with the AI co-founder on 500 planning credits, with community support. Production launches are a paid-plan capability.
rows.competitor: Public and private projects, 1M tokens a month, website hosting, unlimited databases and up to 333k web requests — with Bolt branding on websites.

rows.atai: Full application builds from Starter upward, with up to four production apps on Growth and unlimited on Scale.
rows.competitor: The core product — describe the site or app and Bolt generates and runs it in the browser.

rows.atai: Starter and above: edit code in the editor or visually, download your source code and sync with GitHub. A custom domain of your own arrives with Growth.
rows.competitor: Custom domain support is included from Pro upward.

rows.atai: Deployment is included from Starter upward, with database management and storage; your own custom domain from Growth.
rows.competitor: Bolt Cloud hosting is included: Free covers up to 10 GB bandwidth and 333,333 requests a month; Pro covers up to 30 GB and 1M requests a month.

rows.atai: Database management and storage from Starter upward; expanded capacity on higher plans.
rows.competitor: Unlimited databases on Free, with expanded database capacity and a choice of database provider on Pro.

rows.atai: Specialist teams from Starter, expanded teams on Growth and premium teams with customization on Scale and Enterprise.
rows.competitor: Teams adds centralized billing, team-level access management, granular admin controls and user provisioning, plus private NPM registry support.

rows.atai: Growth adds direct support; Enterprise adds a dedicated account manager and white-glove onboarding.
rows.competitor: Enterprise adds a dedicated account manager, 24/7 priority support, onboarding and SLAs.

rows.atai: Monthly plan credits expire at the end of the month they were issued; permanent top-up credits never expire, so heavy use moves you up a plan.
rows.competitor: Free plan tokens do not roll over; Pro and above roll unused tokens over for up to two months, and the file upload limit rises from 10MB on Free to 100MB on Pro.
